description: Mock API module for role-based learning management system frontend, providing in-memory CRUD operations, localStorage persistence, and seed data for lessons, quizzes, assignments, completions, and employees.

methods.name: getLessons
methods.description: Returns lessons with derived counts for assigned/completed and progress.

methods.name: createLesson
methods.description: Creates a new lesson with optional ID.

methods.name: deleteLesson
methods.description: Deletes a lesson and related quizzes, assignments, and completions.

methods.name: uploadFile
methods.description: Simulates file upload, returning a fake URL and optionally updating lesson file_url.

methods.name: assignLesson
methods.description: Creates an assignment for an employee to a lesson, upserting employee data if name provided.

methods.name: getAssignments
methods.description: Lists assignments for an employee, enriched with lesson titles.

methods.name: completeLesson
methods.description: Marks an assignment as complete and records a completion.

methods.name: getProgress
methods.description: Returns assigned and completed counts and percentage for an employee.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Retrieves employee data by ID, throws if not found.

methods.name: upsertEmployee
methods.description: Creates or updates an employee record.
